_doc: Rebirth milestones. Rebirth N requires the listed area. After the milestones, 'repeatable' applies to every further rebirth. Multipliers stack multiplicatively.
resets: Unlocked areas (you return to the Town and Area 1)
Coin upgrades (Pet Strength, Coin Magnet, Walk Speed)
keeps: All pets (including Huge, Golden, Rainbow, Shiny)
Gem upgrades (Luck, Hatch Speed, Pet Slots, Storage, Gem Finder)
Rank, quests, achievements and pet index

milestones.title: Rebirth I — Fresh Start
milestones.desc: ×1.5 coins forever, +1 pet slot, Auto Hatch unlocked, 500 gems.

milestones.title: Rebirth II — Power Surge
milestones.desc: ×2 pet damage forever, +1 enchant slot, Octo Hatch unlocked, 2,000 gems.

milestones.title: Rebirth III — Fortune's Favour
milestones.desc: ×2 hatch luck, ×1.5 coins forever, +2 pet slots, 6,000 gems.

repeatable.desc: Each further rebirth: ×1.25 coins and ×1.25 damage forever, 10,000 gems.
